content.text:
**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 14.2 Deliverable licence**

The licence grant in Section 13 already satisfies our preferred position: 13.1 names Customer, Affiliates and contractors; 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence for paid-up software and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables; 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation to uncured material breach after notice and cure.

Section 14.2 undercuts that bargain for Deliverables themselves — a licence that is *revocable*, *non-transferable*, term-limited to the Order Form, and silent on Affiliates and contractors. That is at our walk-away line and also conflicts with 14.3, which routes embedded Vendor Technology to the perpetual 13.2 licence.

Redline (validated, ok:true) replaces only the second sentence of 14.2 to conform it to Section 13.2/13.3, extending the licence to Affiliates and contractors, making it perpetual and irrevocable, and permitting transfer to an Affiliate or successor.
